description: List EU pesticide active substances by approval status and dates -- e.g. approvals expiring before a date (expiring_before), all substances still Approved, Not approved, or Pending, candidates for substitution, low-risk substances, or one category (fungicide, herbicide, insecticide...). Each row carries status, approval_state (flags Approved entries whose expiry date has passed), first-approval date and expiry date. Sorted by expiry date for date filters, otherwise by name. Source: European Commission EU Pesticides Database; data_as_of in every answer. Keyless.

candidate_for_substitution.description: Only substances flagged as candidates for substitution.

category.description: Substance category text, e.g. "fungicide", "herbicide", "insecticide", "plant growth regulator".

expiring_after.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD: only substances whose expiry date is on or after it.

expiring_before.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD: only Approved substances whose expiry date is on or before it (includes ones already lapsed).

name: eu_pesticides_list
